learning_outcomes.text: Having sufficient infrastructure in general manufacturing and machining; Being able to use and apply technological knowledge and skills in this field together
Identifying, defining and providing solutions to problems in manufacturing, for this purpose; Ability to choose and apply appropriate methods, programs and modeling techniques
Use and operation of machine tools and tools
Drilling, Turning, Milling, Applications of hole operations in plane surface, channel, stage, pocket and milling
Taking responsibility for technical and manufacturing issues, being able to prepare projects independently or contributing to projects prepared by a group.

syllabus_topics: Introduction of machine tools (drill, shaper, etc.) used in machining; Use of cutters and tools.
Operation types and cutters used in these machines. Sharpening drills and lathe tools. Machining and shaping parts using hand tools. Screw drawing with die and guide.

Safety rules and how to operate the lathe. Introducing the parts of the lathe, showing the types of tools used in the machine, their places of use and ways of using them, and how they are connected to the machine.
Cutting tools used in lathe (lathe tool, center drill, etc.) and preparing them for cutting.
Applications of turning operations: cylindrical turning, Taper turning
Use and operation of milling machine tools and tools.
Milling techniques. Applications of hole milling, surface milling, slot milling, and pocket milling.
Division operations. Gear wheel manufacturing applications and helical milling.
Introducing and using grinding and tool sharpening machines and their auxiliary equipment, their working principles and adjustment.
Fastening, disassembling, balancing, sharpening of workpieces and stones. Choosing the appropriate stone.
